title: A smarter Now Playing
summary: Recently Added is now more useful and stays out of the way during playback, live telemetry takes less space, and Statistics remembers the view you prefer.
highlights: Browse recent movies, series, and episodes on Now Playing, then open any card directly in Jellyfin.
Keep Recently Added compact while something is playing, with a quick Show or Hide control whenever you need it.
See today's watch time, bandwidth, and transcoding in the compact Now Playing header instead of a large footer.
Choose Week, Month, Year, or All time from the clearer Statistics control and save your preferred default view.
See recent Jellyfin device activity, client versions, last users, and active playback inside Statistics.
Get a recognizable Jellydash mascot in Android's notification bar instead of a dark square.
Enjoy the Tabler icon refresh, improved mobile layouts, and the Settings save reminder introduced in v1.4.0.
